title: Swipe Burnout Escape Room
oneLiner: A shareable dating-app fatigue game that turns endless swiping, ghosting, and feeling replaceable into a playful escape-room diagnosis and offline micro-mission.
targetUser: Dating-app users who feel burned out by low-quality matches, ghosting, scams, and algorithm fatigue but still want hope without another generic profile audit.
keyUx: Answer a few swipe fatigue prompts, unlock the user's burnout monster, remix profile boundaries, choose a low-risk offline mission, and export a funny “escaped the swipe maze” card.
externalSignals: Signal 3 — Reddit r/Bumble 2026 dating-app burnout/ghosting/algorithm-fatigue thread: https://www.reddit.com/r/Bumble/comments/1q2l7y2/are_dating_app_still_a_thing_for_u_this_2026/
Signal 4 — Reddit r/TiredofDatingApps community for expensive/ineffective dating app stories: https://www.reddit.com/r/TiredofDatingApps/
stitchPrompt: Design a bold desktop/mobile playful experience called Swipe Burnout Escape Room for dating-app users who feel exhausted by low-quality matches, ghosting, scams, and algorithm fatigue but still want hope without another generic profile audit. It should ask a few swipe fatigue prompts, unlock the user’s burnout monster, remix profile boundaries, choose a low-risk offline micro-mission, and export a funny “escaped the swipe maze” card. Include a swipe fatigue intake, burnout monster reveal, ghosting pattern maze, profile boundary remix cards, offline micro-mission picker, and shareable escape card. Design direction: use a playful-experimental aesthetic with neon maze visuals, charming monster illustrations, kinetic cards, humorous microcopy, and dramatic before/after states so the prototype feels weird, relatable, and highly shareable.
